anomalies.observed: On the CAN BUS sheet, U30 pin 16 (CS) is labeled NET0036, and the same NET0036 label also appears on the CAN transceiver/connector path (e.g. U43 CANH side and J5/J14 pin 2). This places the MCP2515 chip-select net on the same net as a CAN bus signal/connector pin, and the two CAN connectors share corresponding CAN signal labels.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes two separate isolated CAN buses (CAN0/CAN1), each with its own MCP2515 and isolated transceiver. The SPI chip-select for U30 should be a separate GPIO net, and CAN0/CAN1 CANH/CANL nets should not be merged or shared between the two buses.

evidence.quote: CAN BUS sheet: U30 pin 16 CS labeled NET0036; J5 pin 2 and J14 pin 2 also labeled NET0036; U43 CAN path connected to these labels.
two isolated CAN buses (CAN0, CAN1), each driven by its own MCP2515 SPI CAN controller (U8, U9) through an isolated CAN transceiver ... broken out on M12 circular connectors

anomalies.impact: CAN1's SPI chip-select is shorted to a CAN bus line/connector net, preventing proper SPI selection of U30 and loading/merging the CAN bus signals. This would corrupt or disable communication on the affected CAN interface and defeat the intended two-bus architecture.

parsed.summary: The schematic appears to merge an SPI chip-select net with a CAN bus signal net on the CAN1 interface, and the two CAN connectors share corresponding CAN signal labels, contrary to the intended two separate isolated CAN buses.
